A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work, with matching authors, framework, and experiments. All 27 pages of v2 and 28 pages of v3, including their appendices, support comparison; relocated content and renumbered appendices can be matched.

before.justification: v2 reports original LLM bias-auditing experiments across four decision tasks, plus robustness, name-perturbation, and Sobol’ analyses in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results, including Figures 2–7 and Tables 2–7.

M1.justification: v2 Section 2.3 already adopts projection-based steering, but Section 3.4 displays a purely additive intervention. v3 explicitly removes the existing concept projection before steering and presents this as implementation detail. The PDFs do not resolve whether the procedure changed or its earlier description was incomplete.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same judicial, credit-scoring, admissions, and medical tasks. The concept-extraction datasets, alternative Racial Identity vectors, and name-perturbation coverage are also retained.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain the same explicit and implicit black-box comparators, alternative steering-vector comparisons, and unperturbed controls. No comparator is added or removed from the reported comparisons.

E3.justification: The reported experimental design remains unchanged, including 500 judicial sentence pairs, 1,000 credit profiles, evaluated models, task metrics, and steering coefficients from −1 to 1 in increments of 0.2. Appendix A.1 discloses implementation details without reporting revised experimental settings.

E4.justification: The alternative-vector robustness tests, name-based validity analysis, coefficient-response plots, and Sobol’ analyses are retained. v2 Appendices A.1–A.3 become v3 A.2–A.4; the new A.1 contains implementation details rather than another empirical analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report querying each judicial test instance five times and averaging the outcomes. Repetition and uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged, with no added seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: The numerical results, plotted data, and reported empirical findings match across the main text and appendices. For example, Table 3 retains Llama3.1-8B’s −5.11 gendered-language steering score and −0.69 explicit black-box score.

T1.justification: v3 adds explicit definitions and equations for neutral projection removal, the zero-projection property, and percentile-based vector rescaling. The sensitivity equation changes from the unit direction to the scaled vector, and Appendix A.1 discusses the derivative at the neutral activation. These are localized mathematical revisions.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims about white-box sensitivity auditing, detecting dependencies missed by black-box tests, robustness, and concept isolation. The conclusion’s wording changes do not alter their scope.

C2.justification: v3 newly explains neutral repositioning as removing pre-existing concept signals and establishing a common steering origin. It also asserts that repositioning changes only the regression intercept. The interpretations of experimental results and the stated limitations otherwise remain unchanged.

D1.justification: New Appendix A.1 specifies the neutral reference’s training-split source, default 90th/10th-percentile rescaling, intervention at every token position, and per-position projection recomputation. These add concrete implementation information; existing code-access information and task templates are retained.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive research positioning are unchanged. Additional references to Cyberey et al. explain an already adopted approach; the publication and OpenReview notices do not introduce related research.

P1.justification: v3 expands Sections 3.4–3.5, inserts a steering-details appendix, and updates appendix references. It also adds publication information and makes small wording and quotation-mark corrections. The broader narrative and section organization remain stable.

P2.justification: v3 adds publication headers and an OpenReview line, relocates Figure 1 from page 5 to page 6, and reflows surrounding material. Existing figures and tables retain their designs and content; the appendix addition shifts subsequent pages.

improvement.justification: Appendix A.1 supplies useful reproduction details missing from v2. However, the revised neutralization equation makes lambda = 0 correspond to the neutral activation, while Equation 3 still subtracts the original activation’s output. The new assertion that neutralization leaves slopes unchanged also lacks conditions establishing it. These documentation gains coexist with unresolved reasoning about the central metric, preventing a reliable net quality judgment.
